verdict.rationale: First-party docs position Parse as layout-aware 'agentic OCR' that turns scans and images into clean text and markdown, claiming accuracy on scanned pages and handwriting beyond generic OCR. However, nothing addresses the harder conditions this story names, and no hands-on report covers scanned input. Missing for 10: documented handling of skewed/rotated pages, stamps, low-quality or photographed scans, OCR accuracy benchmarks, and independent hands-on corroboration on scanned documents.
